description: Tool catalog for .agents system autonomous agents

tools.name: Agents Tools Discovery
tools.description: Discovers and explores available tools. Lists all tools with descriptions, allows keyword search, and shows complete details including subcommands.
when_to_use: When unsure which tool to use

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available tools with short descriptions

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show detailed information about a specific tool

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search tools by keyword in description and usage

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate schema and consistency of tools.json catalog

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help for tools command

commands.name: smoke
commands.description: Executa smoke tests da CLI tools end-to-end

tools.output: Lista formatada with descriptions, tipos e exemplos de uso
workflow: 1. Agente executa 'tools list' para ver todas as opcoes
4. Agente recebe subcomandos, opcoes e exemplos de uso

tools.name: Agents Doctor
tools.description: Validates the structure e integridade do diretorio .agents. Checks folders obrigatorias, templates, frontmatter YAML, conventions de naming e timestamps.
when_to_use: Before starting trabalho para validar estrutura
After creating nova workstream to verify compliance
When suspected suspeita de problems na estrutura .agents
As part of de validation continua (CI/CD)
checks: Timestamps in ISO 8601 com Z ou offset
tools.output: Report with erros, avisos e informacoes

tools.name: Agents New
tools.description: Creates new workstream com session folder e todos os required files (plan, task, log, etc.) using templates padronizados.
options: --quick: Registers quick task rapida na sessao ativa
tools.output: Session folder em .agents/wb/ with files inicializados

tools.name: Agents Bootstrap
tools.description: Install the .agents system into another repository and generate a project adaptation checklist.
when_to_use: Generate a project-specific adaptation checklist after install

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Preview copy/actions without writing

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Overwrite existing bootstrap-managed files

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Apply and run doctor/tools-check in target repo

checks: Validates target path exists and differs from source repo
Writes adaptation checklist for target project
tools.output: Installed .agents system in target repo and generated bootstrap-adaptation checklist

tools.name: Agents Index
tools.description: Updates arquivos INDEX.md para SPECS e ADRs, escaneando diretorios e extraindo metadados dos frontmatters.
when_to_use: After creating nova decisao de arquitetura (adr.md)
Antes de revisar documentacao de arquitetura
As part of de manutencao de documentacao
tools.output: Indices atualizados com lista de documentos, status, owners e links

tools.name: Agents Lint Docs
tools.description: Valida documentos markdown por consistencia: checkboxes, status, frontmatter, cross-referencias e conventions.
when_to_use: Antes de commitar mudancas em documentacao
Como validation de qualidade em workstream
checks: IDs de tarefa seguem padrao T-NN

tools.name: Agents Structure Map
tools.description: Gera documentacao automatica da estrutura do projeto, incluindo inventario de arquivos, contagem de linhas, tamanhos e descricoes por categoria.
sections: backend: Servicos, APIs, logica de negocio
types: Definicoes de tipo e interfaces

tools.name: Sync Agent Docs
tools.description: Sincroniza documentacao de agentes (QWEN.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) a partir do template AGENTS.md, preservando modificacoes locais quando detectadas.
when_to_use: Apos atualizar AGENTS.md com novas instrucoes
Manter consistencia entre agentes de IA
Propagar mudancas de padrao para todos os agentes
Before starting sessao com multiplos agentes
behavior: Detecta modificacoes locais nos arquivos alvo
tools.output: Arquivos de agente atualizados ou relatorio de diferencas

tools.name: Verify Tasks
tools.description: Verifica se todas as tarefas em uma workstream estao completas, escaneando arquivos task.md e validando markers de status.
when_to_use: Antes de marcar workstream como completa
Validar conclusao de sprint ou fase
Auditoria de tarefas em multiplas sessoes
tools.output: Relatorio de status por tarefa (ID, descricao, status)
tools.exit_code: 0 se todas completas, 1 if has pendencias

tools.name: Agents Workbench Update
tools.description: Automatiza atualizacoes de baixo valor em workstreams: metadata, timestamps, tarefas, status, timeline e links.
when_to_use: Updatesr updated_at apos trabalhar em sessao
Adicionar entrada de timeline no log
Updatesr lista de arquivos modificados no report
Setar status ou links no frontmatter

commands.name: touch
commands.description: Updates updated_at no frontmatter da sessao ativa

commands.name: normalize-time
commands.description: Normaliza timestamps para offset configurado (WB_OFFSET)

commands.name: files-changed
commands.description: Updates secao Files Changed no arquivo report.md

commands.name: task
commands.description: Marca tarefa por ID com status especifico

commands.name: status
commands.description: Seta campo status no frontmatter de um ou mais documentos

commands.name: timeline
commands.description: Adiciona entrada de timeline no arquivo log.md

commands.name: link
commands.description: Seta frontmatter links.<key> = <value>

tools.offset: Usa WB_OFFSET do config para timestamps

tools.name: Agents CLI Wrapper
tools.description: Wrapper bash que executa scripts Python com isolamento de virtualenv via uv. Interface unificada para todas as ferramentas.

tools.name: Skills Sync
tools.description: Synchronize project skills from universal-skills while enforcing strict skills/<name>/SKILL.md structure.
when_to_use: Set up project skill subset from universal-skills
Update local project skills after upstream changes
Validate skill drift and structure contract
Gate full validation with required skills sync checks

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize sync state and local mirror

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Update local mirror from upstream repo

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Preview missing/drift state

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply selected skills to skills/<name>/

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate structure and drift

commands.name: sync
commands.description: pull + apply + check

checks: No forbidden cache/pool directories inside skills/
Drift detection between source mirror and project skills

tools.name: Agents Telemetry
tools.description: Collect, query, and report telemetry data for .agents sessions. Track session metrics, tool usage, task completion, blockers, and generate periodic reports.

commands.name: record
commands.description: Record a telemetry event (session_start, session_end, tool_exec, task_complete, blocker, error, pattern_applied)

commands.name: query
commands.description: Query telemetry events with filters

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export telemetry data to file

commands.name: report
commands.description: Generate telemetry report with metrics and summaries

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate telemetry events against schema

tools.side_effect: Appends event to JSONL telemetry log

tools.name: Agents Patterns
tools.description: Suggest, list, and apply patterns for .agents system usage. Catalog of success patterns, anti-patterns, tool patterns, and template patterns.
when_to_use: Starting new workstream and want proven approaches
Unsure about best practices for a task

commands.name: suggest
commands.description: Suggest relevant patterns based on theme or tags

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all patterns with optional filters

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show detailed pattern information

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply pattern to session (records in telemetry)

commands.name: rate
commands.description: Rate pattern effectiveness

tools.side_effect: Apply records pattern usage in telemetry

verification.usage_pattern: Antes de marcar workstream como completa

automation.description: Automatizam tarefas repetitivas de baixo valor
automation.usage_pattern: Durante trabalho para manter docs atualizados

discovery.usage_pattern: When needing to identify which tool to use

observability.description: Collects and reports usage and performance metrics

on-demand.description: Execucao manual sob comando do usuario/agente

best_practices: Sempre execute make doctor antes de iniciar trabalho
Use make new THEME=x para criar workstreams padronizadas
Execute make verify antes de marcar tarefa como completa
Mantenha docs sincronizados com make sync apos mudar AGENTS.md
Use wb-update para automatizar atualizacoes de baixo valor
Rode make all como validation completa antes de commits
Consulte tools.json para entender quando usar cada ferramenta
